mapper.select: select #{push} time, area, sum(controlNum) controlNum , sum(monitorNum) monitorNum ,sum(c.up) upstreamNum ,sum(c.dw) downstreamNum ,sum(c.up)+sum(c.dw) networkFlowNum from ( select 1 area,0 as entrance_id FROM ntc_entrance_report GROUP BY 1 UNION all select entrance_id area,entrance_id FROM ntc_device_info GROUP BY entrance_id UNION all select 1 area,3 as entrance_id FROM ntc_entrance_report GROUP BY 1 ) d LEFT JOIN (SELECT entrance_id,sum(sum) controlNum from ntc_entrance_report WHERE report_time >= #{start} AND report_time < #{end} AND ( service BETWEEN 16 AND 40 or service BETWEEN 258 AND 273 or service = 576 ) GROUP BY entrance_id) a on d.entrance_id = a.entrance_id left JOIN (SELECT entrance_id,sum(sum) monitorNum from ntc_entrance_report WHERE report_time >= #{start} AND report_time < #{end} AND ( service BETWEEN 128 AND 152 or service BETWEEN 384 AND 513 or service BETWEEN 848 AND 1030 or service = 592 or service = 1152 ) GROUP BY entrance_id ) b ON d.entrance_id = b.entrance_id left JOIN ( select entrance_id , CONVERT(sum(c2s_byte_len)*8/300,int) up,CONVERT( sum(s2c_byte_len)*8/300,int) dw from traffic_protocol_statistic WHERE stat_time >= #{start} AND stat_time < #{end} GROUP BY entrance_id ) c ON d.entrance_id = c.entrance_id GROUP BY area
SELECT report_time time,s_ip src_ip,d_ip dst_ip,service type,sum count FROM ntc_service_behav_statistic where report_time > DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 24 HOUR) ORDER BY report_time desc LIMIT 500;

SELECT #{push} time,entrance_id area,sum(sum) count FROM ntc_entrance_report WHERE report_time >= #{start} AND report_time < #{end} AND ( service BETWEEN 16 AND 40 or service BETWEEN 258 AND 273 or service = 576) GROUP BY entrance_id
SELECT service_id type, count(0) count FROM ui_cfg_num_statistics WHERE cfg_state = 1 GROUP BY service_id ORDER BY count desc;
